page.overview:
Who is Jason?

Jason is a major character in In the Flesh, the second story in Fazbear Frights 5: Bunny Call. He's Matt's best friend and roommate who unknowingly annoys Matt with his chill attitude towards life.

Jason is considered sloppy, unattractive, and poorly dressed by Matt.

Jason is always relaxed and easygoing. He is also nice and caring, trying to remain friendly with Matt despite his friend considering him unsophisticated and unambitious. However, Jason isn’t afraid to take action against Matt when he crosses a line.

Jason is roommates with his friend, Matt, living in an apartment. Jason and Matt have a double date with two girls, Meghan and Eva. Matt angrily leaves and makes them pay the bill, much to Jason's dismay. Fed up with Matt's arrogance, he decides to move out.
